items.titleKo: 터키 에너지부 장관은 4개국과 새로운 프로젝트에 대해 논의하고 있습니다. 5,000 메가와트의 합의와 이라크와의 전기 연결
items.body:
وزير الطاقة التركي يبحث في الرياض مع السعودية والعراق وأوزبكستان وليبيا مشروعات الكهرباء والغاز والهيدروكربونات والطاقة المتجددة.
بحث وزير الطاقة والموارد الطبيعية التركي ألب أرسلان بيرقدار، في العاصمة السعودية الرياض، مع نظرائه في السعودية والعراق وأوزبكستان وليبيا، توسيع التعاون في الطاقة المتجددة وخطوط نقل الكهرباء والغاز الطبيعي ومشروعات الهيدروكربونات.
وجاءت اللقاءات على هامش الدورة الخامسة والعشرين لمؤتمر الطاقة التابع للمجلس العالمي للبترول، حيث ناقش بيرقدار تعزيز أوجه التعاون القائمة وإطلاق مشروعات مشتركة جديدة. ونشر الوزير التركي عبر حساباته على وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي تفاصيل الخطوات التي جرى بحثها مع الدول الأربع.
وخلال لقائه وزير الطاقة السعودي الأمير عبدالعزيز بن سلمان آل سعود، تفقد الوزيران أجنحة معرض مؤتمر البترول العالمي، وبحثا سبل تعزيز التعاون بين البلدين عبر استثمارات جديدة.
items.bodyKo:
터키 에너지부 장관은 리야드에서 사우디아라비아, 이라크, 우즈베키스탄, 리비아의 전기, 가스, 탄화수소 및 신재생 에너지 프로젝트와 논의하고 있습니다.
알프 아르슬란 바이락타르 터키 에너지 천연자원부 장관은 사우디아라비아 수도 리야드에서 사우디아라비아, 이라크, 우즈베키스탄, 리비아와 함께 신재생에너지, 송전선로, 천연가스 및 탄화수소 프로젝트 협력을 확대하는 방안을 논의했다.
이번 회의는 제25차 세계석유평의회 에너지 회의에서 바이락타르가 기존의 협력을 강화하고 새로운 공동 프로젝트를 시작하는 것에 대해 논의하는 자리였다. 터키 장관은 자신의 소셜 미디어 계정을 통해 4개국과 논의한 단계의 세부 사항을 발표했습니다.
압둘아지즈 빈 살만 알 사우드 (Abdulaziz bin Salman Al Saud) 사우디 에너지부 장관과의 면담에서 두 장관은 세계석유회의 전시관을 점검하고 새로운 투자를 통해 양국 간 협력을 강화하는 방안을 논의했다.

items.title: 현대건설, 바스라 사업 재개...완공 앞두고 설비 검증
items.titleKo: 현대건설, 바스라 사업 재개...완공 앞두고 설비 검증
items.body:
[아시아에이=김수빈 기자] 현대건설이 이라크 바스라 정유공장 고도화사업의 마무리 작업을 재개했다. 올해 3월부터 9월까지 현지 정세로 공사가 중단됐지만, 필수 인
13일 본지 취재를 종합하면 현대건설이 맡은 바스라 사업의 설계·조달·시공(EPC)은 실질적인 완공 단계에 도달했다. 현재 작업은 유동접촉분해설비(FCC)의 재가동 준비에 집중돼 있다. 지난해 첫 가솔린 생산과 시운전에 들어간 뒤 올해 공사가 멈췄던 현장으로, 남은 설비 검증을 이어가는 단계다.
◇현지 정세 개선에 재개...지난해 첫 가솔린 생산= 최근 이라크 석유부와 일본 측의 가동 협의도 사업 재개를 위한 절차였다. 현대건설은 지난 12일 본지 질의에 현지 정세가 개선되고 지난 9월 일본 외무성이 이라크 안전등급을 조정하면서 프로젝트를 다시 진행하게 됐다고 설명했다.
앞서 중동 건설·플랜트 전문매체 MEED는 지난 8일 이라크 석유부가 일본대사관과 일본국제협력기구(JICA), JGC 관계자들과 FCC 설비 가동 방안을 논의했다고 보도했다. 회의에서는 설비 가동을 위한 실행 절차와 이라크 당국·일본 측의 협력 방안을 다뤘다.
바스라 고도화사업은 원유 정제 과정에서 남는 잔사유를 활용해 하루 2만4000배럴의 가솔린을 생산하는 설비를 짓는 프로젝트다. 현대건설과 JGC가 공동 수행하는 전체 사업 규모는 37억7800만달러다. 현대건설은 2020년 사업을 수주해 EPC를 수행해 왔다.
현대건설은 지난해 10월 주요 공사를 완료하고 시운전에 돌입했다고 발표했다. 같은 달 25일에는 이라크 정부 인사들이 참석한 가운데 첫 가솔린 생산 기념행사를 열었다. 올해 공사 중단은 이처럼 시공이 상당 부분 마무리된 상태에서 발생했다.

يثير تعديل سعر صرف الدولار بالعراق مخاوف من ارتفاع الأسعار وتراجع القدرة الشرائية وسط اعتراضات تجارية ودعوات لدعم القطاع الخاص وزيادة الإنتاج لتخفيف الضغوط المالية وتقليص الاعتماد على الاستيراد.

items.body:
في 12 أكتوبر 2026، التقى وزير الطاقة والموارد الطبيعية التركي ألب أرسلان بيرقدار بنظرائه من السعودية والعراق ليبيا خلال زيارته للعاصمة السعودية الرياض، وفق ما
خلال لقائه وزير الطاقة السعودي الأمير عبد العزيز بن سلمان آل سعود، تفقد بيرقدار الأجنحة المشاركة في معرض المؤتمر الذي شارك في افتتاحه. وأشار إلى أن اتفاقية الطاقة المتجددة بقدرة خمسة آلاف ميغاوات الموقعة بين البلدين هذا العام أسست لتعاون استراتيجي شامل في جميع مجالات الطاقة عبر استثمارات جديدة. ونقل عنه قوله: “سنواصل تقوية صداقتنا وتعاوننا مع السعودية من أجل السلام الإقليمي والازدهار المشترك”.

items.bodyKo:
2026년 10월 12일, 알프 아르슬란 바이락타르 터키 에너지 천연자원부 장관은 사우디아라비아 수도 리야드를 방문하는 동안 사우디아라비아와 이라크에서 온 동료들과 만났다.
압둘아지즈 빈 살만 알 사우드 사우디 에너지부 장관과의 면담에서 바이락타르는 자신이 참여한 컨퍼런스 전시회에 참가한 파빌리온을 점검했다. 그는 올해 양국 간에 체결된 5천 메가와트 규모의 신재생에너지 협약이 신규 투자를 통해 모든 에너지 분야에서 포괄적인 전략적 협력을 구축했다고 지적했다. 그는 "우리는 지역 평화와 공동 번영을 위해 사우디아라비아와의 우정과 협력을 계속 강화할 것" 이라고 말했다.
이라크의 알리 사디 와히브 (Ali Saadi Wahib) 전력부 장관과의 면담과 관련해, 바이락타르 장관은 양측이 석유 및 가스 분야에서 터키와 이라크 간의 견고한 협력 수준을 발전 단계로 끌어올리려는 의도를 공유하고 있다고 밝혔다. 그들은 지역 공급의 안보를 지원하는 전력 상호 연결 및 에너지 전송 인프라 프로젝트를 가속화하고 이 분야에 대한 공동 투자를 늘리기로 합의했습니다. 바이락타르는 리비아의 칼리파 압델 사데크 석유 및 가스부 장관과의 면담에서 석유 및 가스 분야에서 진행 중인 활동에 대해 논의했다.

items.titleKo: 이라크는 디나르 평가 절하 이틀 후 새로운 사역의 무게
items.body:
Shafaq News- Baghdad Two days after Iraq devalued the dinar amid mounting pressure to keep public salaries flowing, former lawmaker Amir al-Maamouri revealed that political blocs had reached unders
According to al-Maamouri, the plans include a ministry for artificial intelligence or digital investment, and splitting the Ministry of Culture, Tourism and Antiquities into separate culture and tourism portfolios. “The new posts would be shared out under the quota system to satisfy the parties.” Al-Zaidi was considering merging ministries to cut costs.
The talks come at a moment of acute fiscal strain. On October 6, the Council of Ministers raised the official end-user rate from 1,320 to 1,520 dinars per dollar. Iraq earns nearly all its revenue in dollars from oil, so a weaker dinar gives the treasury more local currency for every barrel sold. The same change raises the cost of imports for a population whose salaries, pensions and savings are held in dinars.

items.title: PKK leaves four camps in Iraq, Turkish sources say — Cyprus Mail
items.titleKo: PKK는 이라크에 4개의 캠프를 남겨두고 있으며, 터키 소식통은 — 키프로스 우편
items.body:
PKK militants have left four camps in northern Iraq, Turkish security sources said, calling it a first step toward the organization's planned dissolution.
--> Militants of the Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) have left four camps in the Metina region of northern Iraq. This was the first step toward the planned dissolution of the organization, Turkish security sources said, Cyprus Mail reports .
According to the sources, since last Thursday the PKK has left the Gebat, Yayik, Sabri and Sason camps in the Baze area. Turkish security sources described this as evidence of progress in the peace process.
In August, Turkey's parliament adopted a law defining the parameters for the PKK's dissolution. The legislation provides protection for many former militants who have not committed certain crimes and also allows sentences to be suspended for some people convicted of membership in the organization. This is intended to facilitate their reintegration into society.

items.title: Erbil governor says kerosene handout is ready but the Kurdistan Region is still waiting for Baghdad

items.body:
Governor Omed Khoshnaw said the distribution schedule is set, while barrel prices on the open market have roughly doubled since May.
ERBIL, October 12, 2026. Erbil’s governor said on Monday that the province is ready to hand out household kerosene for the winter but cannot start until Baghdad sends the Kurdistan Region its share.
“The distribution schedule is ready. We are only waiting for Baghdad to set our quantity and deliver it, and then we will start distributing straight away,” Governor Omed Khoshnaw told Rudaw .
He said the Kurdistan Region’s Ministry of Natural Resources was in talks with the federal Oil Ministry to have the fuel sent as soon as possible.
“We ask Iraq to treat us like the other provinces and give us our share,” he said.
No start date has been set in the Kurdistan Region. In previous years, distribution began in September.

Tom Barrack meets Iraq’s top judge Faiq Zaidan in Baghdad
Baghdad (IraqiNews.com) – US Envoy Tom Barrack met with Iraq’s top judicial leadership in Baghdad on Monday, as Washington and Baghdad strive to rebuild their bilateral relationship in the face of regional tensions and a shifting security situation.
Barrack met with Judge Faiq Zaidan, President of Iraq’s Supreme Judicial Council, to explore ways to strengthen bilateral legal and judicial collaboration.
The meeting comes at a difficult time for the region, after fatal assaults on Riyadh’s international airport over the weekend, which Saudi officials blamed on Yemen’s Houthi movement.
In a statement issued after the negotiations, Barrack praised his meeting with Zaidan as positive and emphasized the necessity of an independent judiciary for Iraq’s future.

협상 후 발표된 성명에서 Barrack은 Zaidan과의 만남을 긍정적으로 칭찬하고 이라크의 미래를 위해 독립적인 사법부의 필요성을 강조했습니다.

items.title: PKK withdraws from Turkish border area in Iraqi Kurdistan
items.titleKo: 이라크 쿠르디스탄의 터키 국경 지역에서 PKK 철수
items.body:
Turkish security sources confirm move as part of militant group's dissolution process
Militants from the Kurdistan Workers’ Party (PKK) have withdrawn from four camps in northern Iraq , Turkish security sources said on Monday, as part of a drawn-out disarmament process that could eventually include the return of former militants to Turkey .
Fighters from the PKK withdrew from “four shelters” in the Metina area near the border with Turkey in Iraq’s Kurdistan region, security sources told state news agency Anadolu.
The PKK last week said it had evacuated four “war tunnels” in the Metina area and withdrawn fighters from Turkey in the days before that. The moves showed it had “fulfilled” its strategy “to end the armed struggle against Turkey”, the group said.
The Turkish sources did not mention withdrawals from Turkey but said the PKK's departure from the locations in Iraq’s Kurdistan region was part of efforts to evacuate locations that “pose a risk of conflict to Turkey’s security”.

items.title: Iranian drones attack KDPI camp in Iraq’s Koya — Jerusalem Post
items.titleKo: 이란 드론, 이라크 코야의 KDPI 캠프 공격
items.body:
Iranian drones struck the KDPI’s Azadi camp in Koya, northern Iraq. The camp had been evacuated, and no casualties were reported.
--> Iranian drones attacked the Azadi camp of the Kurdistan Democratic Party of Iran (KDPI) in the city of Koya in the Kurdistan Region of northern Iraq. The Jerusalem Post reported this, citing a party statement and local Kurdish media.
The KDPI said that one drone struck the camp at 12:01 p.m. According to Rudaw, two drones hit the facility in the Koya district of Erbil province. A senior party official and a security source told the outlet that there was material damage, while no one was killed or injured.
As Rudaw notes, the camp was evacuated before the attack, so no one remained on its territory. A security source also confirmed a second drone strike on the same location.

items.title: العراق يريد الاستفادة من خبرات الجزائر في قطاع الغاز
items.source: أول منصة عربية متخصصة في أخبار الطاقة
items.titleKo: 이라크는 가스
items.body:
يتجه العراق إلى تعزيز التعاون مع الجزائر في قطاع الغاز الطبيعي، ضمن مساعيه إلى تطوير استغلال موارده الطبيعية، خاصة الغاز المصاحب، بما يدعم الاستفادة
وبحسب ما اطّلعت عليه منصة الطاقة المتخصصة (مقرها واشنطن)، بحث وزير النفط العراقي باسم محمد خضير مع وزير الدولة وزير المحروقات الجزائري محمد عرقاب فرص التعاون في قطاع المحروقات ، خلال لقاء جمعهما على هامش فعاليات أسبوع الطاقة بالرياض، اليوم الإثنين 12 أكتوبر/تشرين الأول 2026.
وركّزت المباحثات على إمكان الاستفادة من الخبرات الجزائرية في جمع الغاز المصاحب ومعالجته واستغلاله، إلى جانب تطوير الشراكات الاستثمارية بين الشركات النفطية في البلدين.
وتأتي التحركات في وقت يعمل فيه العراق على تنفيذ مشروعات لزيادة إنتاج الغاز المحلي، وتقليل الكميات المحروقة، وتوفير إمدادات إضافية من الوقود لمحطات توليد الكهرباء.
شكّل تطوير قدرات جمع الغاز المصاحب ومعالجته أحد أبرز محاور المباحثات العراقية الجزائرية، في ظل اهتمام بغداد بتعظيم الاستفادة من الموارد الغازية المتاحة، وتحويلها إلى منتجات ذات قيمة اقتصادية.

토론에서는 양국의 석유 회사 간 투자 파트너십을 개발하는 것 외에도 수반 가스 수집, 처리 및 활용에 대한 알제리의 전문 지식을 활용할 수 있는 가능성에 초점을 맞췄습니다.

수반가스 수집 및 처리 능력 개발은 가용 가스 자원의 활용을 극대화하고 이를 경제적 가치가 있는 제품으로 전환하려는 바그다드의 관심에 비추어 볼 때 이라크-알제리 논의에서 가장 두드러진 축 중 하나였습니다.

Shafaq News- Mosul Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi said on Monday that the government had formally invited international companies specializing in airport management and operations to invest in Mos
During a visit to Mosul, al-Zaidi reviewed service and development projects, including the airport, and launched implementation work on a national initiative to distribute one million residential plots across Iraq.
Al-Zaidi said the government wanted international companies to do more than build a passenger terminal, emphasizing that it sought partners to help develop the airport and improve its services.
The prime minister also laid the foundation stone for a residential land distribution project described as Nineveh’s largest. The ceremony took place in the Damirji area, also known as Bab al-Sham, west of Mosul, as part of the national initiative to distribute one million residential plots to eligible citizens.

총리는 또한 니네베 최대 규모로 묘사되는 주거용 토지 분배 프로젝트의 초석을 놓았습니다. 이 행사는 적격 시민에게 100만 개의 주거용 부지를 배포하려는 국가 계획의 일환으로 모술 서쪽의 Bab al-Sham으로도 알려진 Damirji 지역에서 열렸습니다.

items.body:
Talks focus on completing Iraq’s cabinet, approving the federal budget, and resolving outstanding disputes between Erbil and Baghdad
ERBIL (Kurdistan24) — President Masoud Barzani received former Iraqi Prime Minister Mohammed Shia al-Sudani in Pirmam on Monday, for talks on the political situation in Iraq and the wider region, as well as efforts to complete the federal government’s cabinet and address outstanding issues between Erbil and Baghdad.
Sudani, who heads the Reconstruction and Development Coalition, met with Barzani to discuss the need to complete the formation of the federal government’s ministerial lineup and support its work, according to a statement on the meeting.
The discussions also addressed the federal budget, the enactment of necessary legislation, and ways to resolve disputes between the Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG) and the federal government in Baghdad.

items.body:
Iraq appoints Ahmed Nayef Al Dulaimi as ambassador to Saudi Arabia
The national flags of Iraq and Saudi Arabia. Photo: Gulf Leaders Circle
Baghdad (IraqiNews.com) – The Iraqi Ministry of Foreign Affairs issued an official ministerial decree transferring Ambassador Ahmed Nayef Rashid Al-Dulaimi to head the Iraqi Embassy in Riyadh as Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary, succeeding Ambassador Safia Al-Suhail.
The high-level diplomatic reshuffle comes directly ahead of an official Gulf tour by Prime Minister Ali Al-Zaidi, scheduled to begin with an executive visit to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia followed by bilateral engagements in Kuwait.
A formal document confirmed that the decree, issued by the administrative department of the foreign ministry and signed by Foreign Minister Fuad Hussein, designates Al-Dulaimi as head of mission in the Saudi capital, taking formal effect from the date of his administrative detachment from his previous diplomatic post.

items.body:
لم يعد ارتفاع سعر الدولار ينعكس على أسعار السلع المستوردة فحسب، بل امتد أثره إلى كلفة صيانة السيارات والأجهزة الكهربائية والأثاث في العراق، مع ارتفاع أسعار قطع الغيار والمواد الأولية، ما دفع مواطنين إلى تأجيل التصليح أو اللجوء إلى بدائل أقل كلفة، فيما بات أصحاب بعض المهن يواجهون تراجعاً في الطلب على منتجاتهم وخدماتهم.
وبينما يواجه المواطن ارتفاعاً في كلفة شراء الأجهزة الجديدة وقطع تبديل السيارات، أصبحت الأعطال المنزلية والمركبات المتضررة مصدراً إضافياً للإنفاق، خصوصاً أن جزءاً من مستلزمات الصيانة يعتمد على الاستيراد، ما يجعل أسعارها عرضة للتأثر بتحركات سعر صرف الدولار وكلف الشحن والتوزيع.
وقال المواطن مفيد علي، لوكالة شفق نيوز، إن صيانة السيارات والأجهزة الكهربائية أصبحت مكلفة بسبب ارتفاع أسعار قطع الغيار، مبيناً أنه غالباً ما يؤجل إصلاح سيارته في حال تعرضها لحادث، نتيجة ارتفاع أسعار القطع وأجور أصحاب ورش التصليح.

Iraq says the first components of a new nationwide air-defense system will arrive within six months, as Baghdad also highlights strong coordination with Peshmerga forces.

Numan said Iraqi authorities had advanced negotiations and agreements with companies supplying air-defense systems, with the aim of establishing nationwide coverage.
"We have made good progress in securing an air-defense system and reaching agreements with companies to provide air-defense systems covering all of Iraq," Numan said.
